items.title: Understanding Consequences of Unethical Digital Behavior (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Understanding Consequences of Unethical Digital Behavior (PDF 135, printed 131).

blocks.text: Ghair-akhlaqi digital rawaiye mein hacking, jhooti maloomat phailana ya cyberbullying (online tang karna) shamil ho sakte hain. Aise kaam nuqsan pohancha sakte, saakh kharab kar sakte aur qanooni nataij la sakte hain. Online chhote kaam bhi bare asraat rakh sakte hain. Ghair-akhlaqi rawaiye ke nataij samajhna zimmedarana digital rawaiye ki himmat afzai karta hai. Akhlaqi miyar barqarar rakhna zyada mehfooz aur qabil-e-bharosa online mahol yaqeeni banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ghair-akhlaqi digital rawaiye ki teen misalein aur us ke do nataij batayein.
blocks.explanation: Hacking, jhooti maloomat phailana, cyberbullying (online tang karna). Nataij: nuqsan, reputation kharab, qanooni karwai.

items: Unethical behavior: hacking, false information, cyberbullying.
Chhoti online harkat bhi bara asar; akhlaqi miyar se mehfooz mahol.
